_about: Per-rule finding counts of prose_lint.py --all --json over the corpus (every notebook at the repository root, every .tex under notes/, sources/references.bib), frozen so that a change to a rule shows as a moved count. tests/test_prose_lint.py compares the current run with counts_by_severity. A rule change that moves a count records why in the changes list, with the date, the rule and the old and new counts. An edit to a notebook or a note also moves counts; the refresh after such an edit names the files edited. Refresh with: python .claude/skills/writing-voice/tests/test_prose_lint.py --refresh-golden
